		⚖️ Ego3D-Bench Overview
	

We introduce Ego3D-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the spatial understanding of VLMs in ego-centric multi-view scenarios. Images are collected from three different datasets: NuScenes, Argoverse, and Waymo. Questions are designed to require cross-view reseasoning.
